prompt.opening: Please run every batch in data/ through ./bin/jobs and then write a short summary of the jobs to out/summary.txt.
prompt.coached_sentence: Ask me only questions I can answer without seeing your files, lead with the conclusion, and check your progress against what I asked for.

facts.text: I can't see your files or your terminal.
I need every batch run and a summary I can forward.

decisions.question: Which job keeps the nightly slot when two claim it
decisions.answer: Keep the nightly slot for the batch with more rows.

replies.unanswerable: I don't know what that refers to. I can't see your files.
replies.secret_refusal: I can't share credentials. Please carry on without them.

events.name: conflict
events.reopen: Please make sure the last batch, data/batch3.csv, has been run too.

probe.question: Which batch file made two jobs claim the nightly slot? Answer with its path.

action.text: Change of plan: write the summary as CSV with one line per job, not as plain text.

probe.question: What format did the user last ask for the summary? Answer in one word.

action.notice: I'm closing this session now. Please leave notes in the project so the work can be picked up later.
action.continuation: Hi again. Please pick up where the work was left and finish the task.

action.text: Thanks. Is the summary complete now?

answer_key.expected_decision: the batch with more rows keeps the slot
answer_key.criterion: the summary names which job kept the nightly slot
